guide:
Nodal agent API. You drive a live Nodal window: every edit appears on the user's canvas as you make it, with your own cursor and an activity log. Your work is independent of the user's selection, tool, page and viewport: always pass explicit ids, coordinates and (optionally) a page; nothing here reads what the user clicked. Edits you make are not on the user's undo stack (use history.undo for yours).

Workflow: session.start {name, goal} first, then build, then session.done {summary}. While you are working the user may be prevented from editing what you made (the guard; the user decides). Use session.say to narrate, doc.screenshot to look at the result, check.run to verify wiring.

Coordinates: world pixels, x right, y DOWN. The grid is doc.settings.grid (default 10); keep parts and wire points on it. A typical 2-pin part (resistor) is 60–80 px long. Rotation is 0/90/180/270 clockwise.

Items (doc.items, keyed by id): component (a placed symbol: symbol, x, y = its centre, rot, flipX, ref like R1, value like 10k, props), wire (a, b endpoints + pts bends), junction (solder dot x, y), shape (kind rect|zone|ellipse|polygon|line|arrow|text|image|ink|callout|frame, box x y w h, styling). Wire endpoints: {kind:'port', comp, port} | {kind:'junction', id} | {kind:'free', x, y}.

Wiring: prefer wires.connect with port targets ({ref:'R1', port:'2'} or {comp:id, port:'name or id'}); it routes orthogonally around parts and makes junctions where you land on a wire. components.ports tells you each pin's id, name and absolute position. Nets also join by name: place 'net-label' / 'gnd' / 'vcc' symbols with the same value on several pins.

Pages: a document has one or more pages; methods taking 'page' default to your working page (session.setPage), never the user's page.

Symbols: symbols.list / symbols.get give the library (ids like 'resistor', 'capacitor', 'dc-source', 'gnd', 'vcc', 'net-label', 'opamp'). symbols.create adds a custom symbol drawn in the symbol DSL: one command per line — W w (stroke width), SC colour, FC colour, DA 1|0 (dashed), L x1 y1 x2 y2 … (polyline), G … (closed polygon, GF filled, GB background-filled), R x y w h [rx] (RF, RB), C cx cy r (CF, CB), E cx cy rx ry, A cx cy r a1 a2 (arc, degrees clockwise from +x), P <svg path> (PF, PB), T x y size s|m|e text. Ports: 'name:x,y name2:x,y' in symbol-local px (origin top-left).

Batching: batch {calls:[{method, params}]} runs many edits as ONE step (one undo, one repaint); later calls can use ids from earlier ones via "$0.id" / "$2.ids.0" strings (result of call #n, dotted path).

Errors come back as {error:{code, message}}. Read-only methods never change anything.

methods.name: nodal.describe
methods.summary: This guide plus every method with its parameters.

methods.name: nodal.ping
methods.summary: Checks the app is connected; returns its version and the open document's id and name.

methods.name: session.start
methods.summary: Starts (or restarts) your work session: shows you in the app as working, with your name and goal. Call before editing.

params.goal?: string — one line on what you are about to do
params.color?: string — CSS colour of your cursor

methods.name: session.status
methods.summary: Your session (status, guard mode chosen by the user, working page, items you own, follow mode) and whether the circuit can be edited at all.

methods.name: session.say
methods.summary: Shows a message to the user (activity log and a bubble at your cursor).

methods.name: session.progress
methods.summary: Updates the progress shown in the agent panel.

params.text?: string — what you are doing now

methods.name: session.done
methods.summary: Marks your work finished: the guard is lifted and the user gets a notification with your summary.

methods.name: session.setPage
methods.summary: Sets your working page (default target of every edit). Does not change what the user looks at.

methods.name: session.pointAt
methods.summary: Moves your cursor (what the user sees you looking at) to a point or to items.

methods.name: session.log
methods.summary: Recent entries of the activity log the user sees.

methods.name: session.waitForUser
methods.summary: Waits until the user replies in the agent panel (or the timeout passes) and returns their reply. Use for questions that need a human decision.

params.question: string — shown in the panel with a reply box
params.choices?: string[] — optional quick answers shown as buttons

methods.name: app.state
methods.summary: What the user is doing: page in view, selection, tool, viewport, theme, open dialog, read-only modes, file path, unsaved changes, live-session status, symbol editor open.

methods.name: app.prefs
methods.summary: Reads the app preferences.

methods.name: app.setPrefs
methods.summary: Changes app preferences (theme, wireAvoid, wireAngle, showMinimap, autosave…). Affects the user's UI.

methods.name: app.toast
methods.summary: Shows a short notification at the bottom of the window.

methods.name: app.commands
methods.summary: Lists the app's UI commands (menu / palette entries) with ids and shortcuts.

methods.name: app.runCommand
methods.summary: Runs a UI command exactly as the user would (it acts on the USER's selection, page and view — prefer the dedicated methods for edits).

methods.name: user.select
methods.summary: Selects items for the user (switching the user's page if needed) — e.g. to show them what you mean.

methods.name: user.show
methods.summary: Moves the user's view to items or a rectangle (switching page if needed).

methods.name: user.setPage
methods.summary: Switches the page the user is looking at.

methods.name: user.setFollow
methods.summary: Turns 'follow the agent' on or off (the user's view tracks your edits). The user can change it too.

methods.name: doc.get
methods.summary: The whole document as JSON (format 'nodal'), or one page of it.

params.symbols?: boolean — include custom symbol definitions (default true)

methods.name: doc.summary
methods.summary: Compact overview: name, pages with item counts, bounds, every part (ref, symbol, value, position) and how many wires / shapes / nets there are.

methods.name: doc.new
methods.summary: Replaces the open circuit with a new empty one (the old one is kept as a version in history first).

methods.name: doc.load
methods.summary: Replaces the open circuit with the given document (object or JSON text). The old one is kept as a version first.

params.doc: any — a Nodal document object or its JSON text

methods.name: doc.rename
methods.summary: Renames the circuit.

methods.name: doc.settings
methods.summary: Reads the document settings (grid, wire style, hops, junction size, colours, title block, sheet…).

methods.name: doc.setSettings
methods.summary: Changes document settings; nested objects (wire, sheet) are merged.

methods.name: doc.insert
methods.summary: Inserts another circuit or fragment (its items get new ids) offset by dx, dy on a page. Returns the new ids.

params.doc: any — Nodal document, fragment ({format:'nodal-fragment', items, groups, symbols}) or template, object or JSON text

methods.name: doc.save
methods.summary: Saves the circuit: desktop app writes to its file (or 'path'); the web app downloads it.

params.path?: string — desktop only: file to write

methods.name: doc.export
methods.summary: Exports and returns the content: svg / dxf / spice / kicad / bom / json as text, png as base64.

methods.name: doc.screenshot
methods.summary: Renders a page (or items / an area) to a PNG so you can see the drawing. Returns base64 PNG plus its world bounds.

methods.name: doc.stats
methods.summary: Counts of parts, wires, junctions, shapes, nets and pages.

methods.name: pages.list
methods.summary: Pages in tab order with item counts; marks your working page and the user's page.

methods.name: pages.add
methods.summary: Adds a page; returns its id.

methods.name: pages.rename
methods.summary: Renames a page.

methods.name: pages.delete
methods.summary: Deletes a page and everything on it (not the last page).

methods.name: pages.duplicate
methods.summary: Copies a page with all its items; returns the new page id.

methods.name: pages.move
methods.summary: Moves a page to a position in the tab row (0 = first).

methods.name: items.list
methods.summary: Lists items compactly, filtered. Components show ref / symbol / value; wires their ends; shapes kind and text.

params.page?: string — default your working page; 'all' for every page
params.text?: string — matches ref, value, label or text

methods.name: items.get
methods.summary: Full items by id (or component ref), with bounds; components also get their pins' positions.

methods.name: items.create
methods.summary: Creates raw items (any type, full control of fields). Missing ids are generated; components get default ref / value / props from their symbol when omitted. Wire endpoints may name parts by ref.

params.items: object[] — partial Item objects with at least type

methods.name: items.update
methods.summary: Changes fields of items (shallow merge; nested objects like style / labelStyle / props are merged). 'unset' removes fields.

methods.name: items.delete
methods.summary: Deletes items; wires attached to deleted parts keep their shape.

methods.name: items.move
methods.summary: Moves items by dx, dy; connected wires follow (like dragging).

methods.name: items.moveTo
methods.summary: Moves items so the first one's position (x, y) lands at the given point; the rest keep their offsets.

methods.name: items.rotate
methods.summary: Turns items a quarter (or half) turn about their common centre (or 'pivot'); wires follow.

methods.name: items.rotateShape
methods.summary: Turns one shape by any angle about its centre (or a pivot).

methods.name: items.flip
methods.summary: Mirrors items left-right (x) or up-down (y).

methods.name: items.scale
methods.summary: Scales items about a pivot (default their centre).

methods.name: items.align
methods.summary: Aligns items' edges or centres.

methods.name: items.distribute
methods.summary: Spaces items evenly along an axis.

methods.name: items.matchSize
methods.summary: Gives shapes the size of the first one.

methods.name: items.restack
methods.summary: Changes stacking order.

methods.name: items.duplicate
methods.summary: Copies items (with the wires between them) offset by dx, dy, optionally onto another page; returns new ids.

methods.name: items.moveToPage
methods.summary: Moves items to another page.

methods.name: items.lock
methods.summary: Locks or unlocks items.

methods.name: items.hide
methods.summary: Hides or shows items.

methods.name: items.style
methods.summary: Applies a look to any items, with the Style panel's keys: line (colour), fill, fillOpacity, width, dash, text (text colour), size, bold, italic, underline, allCaps, font (''|serif|mono), align, valign, wrapW, lineOpacity, cap, join, radius, fillKind (none|solid|gradient), fill2, gradAngle, opacity, shadow. Keys that don't apply to an item are ignored.

methods.name: items.getStyle
methods.summary: Reads the look of items (common values, and which keys differ).

methods.name: items.find
methods.summary: Finds items by text in refs, values, wire labels, shape text and props, across all pages.

methods.name: items.template
methods.summary: Items (with the wires between them) as a reusable template file (format 'nodal-template'); doc.insert puts it back.

methods.name: groups.list
methods.summary: Groups with their members.

methods.name: groups.create
methods.summary: Groups items; returns the group id.

methods.name: groups.ungroup
methods.summary: Takes items out of their (outermost) groups.

methods.name: groups.rename
methods.summary: Renames a group.

methods.name: components.place
methods.summary: Places a part from the library, centred on x, y. Returns its id, ref and pins with absolute positions (wire to those).

params.style?: object — color, fill, lineWidth, dash, scale, labelColor…

methods.name: components.placeMany
methods.summary: Places several parts in one step (same fields as components.place each).

methods.name: components.ports
methods.summary: Pins of a part: id, name, absolute position, side, and what is connected (wires, net name).

methods.name: components.setSymbol
methods.summary: Swaps the symbol a part is drawn with (e.g. another type of the same part), keeping its position and labels.

methods.name: components.annotate
methods.summary: Renumbers every part's reference left-to-right, top-to-bottom, page by page.

methods.name: wires.connect
methods.summary: Draws a wire between two targets, routed orthogonally around parts. A target is a pin {ref|comp, port}, a junction {junction}, a point on a wire {wire, x, y} (makes a junction there) or a loose point {x, y}. Returns the wire id.

params.via?: object[] — bend points {x,y} to pass through

methods.name: wires.connectMany
methods.summary: Several wires.connect in one step; returns their ids (null where nothing was drawn).

params.wires: object[] — each {from, to, via?, angle?, style?, label?}

methods.name: wires.path
methods.summary: Draws a wire exactly through given points (no routing); ends snap to pins, junctions or wires lying on them.

methods.name: wires.reroute
methods.summary: Re-routes wires around parts (all wires on the page when no ids).

methods.name: wires.junction
methods.summary: Joins wires that cross or meet at a point with a solder dot (or adds a free junction).

methods.name: wires.unsolder
methods.summary: Removes a junction (the wires through it stay joined as one) or disconnects a pin.

methods.name: wires.label
methods.summary: Names a wire (its net) and places the label.

methods.name: wires.deletePart
methods.summary: Deletes one bend (node) or one segment of a wire: an end segment shortens it, a middle one splits it in two.

params.index: integer — node index (0 = end a) or segment index

methods.name: shapes.add
methods.summary: Adds a shape. Boxes use x, y, w, h; line / arrow use from / to (points or {id} to glue to an item) and optional bends; polygon / path use points; text uses text and fontSize; callout uses text and anchor {x,y} or {id}; image uses src (data URL); ink uses points with optional pressure p.

params.from?: object — line/arrow start {x,y} or {id, fx?, fy?}
params.props?: object — any ShapeItem fields (stroke, fill, fillOpacity, strokeWidth, dash, radius, fontSize, textColor, bold, route, headEnd…)

methods.name: shapes.presets
methods.summary: Lists the shape presets (flowchart, arrows, basic).

methods.name: shapes.addPreset
methods.summary: Adds a preset shape (e.g. a flowchart decision).

methods.name: shapes.connect
methods.summary: Draws a connector (arrow or line) glued between two items, so it follows them.

methods.name: shapes.note
methods.summary: Adds a callout pointing at items (or a point) with text — handy to explain your work.

methods.name: shapes.toPath
methods.summary: Turns rectangles, ellipses and unattached lines into editable paths (polygons with curves).

methods.name: symbols.list
methods.summary: Library symbols (built-in, the user's and the document's), filtered.

params.query?: string — words in name, id, category or keywords

methods.name: symbols.categories
methods.summary: Symbol categories with counts.

methods.name: symbols.get
methods.summary: A symbol's full definition: size, pins (id, name, local x, y, side), fields, prefix, types, and its DSL source.

methods.name: symbols.create
methods.summary: Creates (or replaces) a custom symbol from DSL source; it is stored in the document and, optionally, in the user's library. Returns its id.

methods.name: symbols.fromSvg
methods.summary: Creates a custom symbol from SVG markup (its drawing), with pins you name.

methods.name: symbols.fromItems
methods.summary: Turns items into a new symbol; with replace, they are swapped for one instance of it.

methods.name: symbols.delete
methods.summary: Removes a custom symbol from the user's library (parts using it keep their copy).

methods.name: symbols.importLibrary
methods.summary: Adds the symbols of a Nodal library file (format 'nodal-library') to the user's library.

params.library: any — library object or its JSON text
params.overwrite?: boolean — replace symbols with the same id

methods.name: symbols.exportLibrary
methods.summary: The user's library as a Nodal library file (to save or share).

methods.name: nets.list
methods.summary: Electrical nets: name, label names, wires and pins (ref.port).

params.page?: string — only nets touching this page

methods.name: nets.of
methods.summary: The net of a pin or wire.

methods.name: check.run
methods.summary: Runs the electrical rules check: unconnected pins, duplicate refs, shorts, loose ends… (issues the user chose to ignore are listed apart).

methods.name: check.ignore
methods.summary: Marks rule-check issues as ignored (or not).

methods.name: history.undo
methods.summary: Undoes your last step (only yours; refused if the user has changed the same items since).

params.force?: boolean — undo even over later changes

methods.name: history.redo
methods.summary: Redoes your last undone step.

methods.name: history.steps
methods.summary: Your steps so far (labels, item counts), newest last.

methods.name: versions.save
methods.summary: Saves a named version of the circuit in its version history.

methods.name: versions.list
methods.summary: Saved versions of the open circuit.

methods.name: versions.restore
methods.summary: Opens a saved version in place of the circuit (the current state is saved as a version first).

methods.name: symbolEditor.open
methods.summary: Opens the user's symbol editor page on a symbol (or a new one). UI action.

methods.name: symbolEditor.close
methods.summary: Closes the symbol editor page without saving.

methods.name: batch
methods.summary: Runs several calls as ONE step (one undo step, one repaint). Strings like "$0.id" refer to earlier results (call index, dotted path). Stops at the first error and undoes the whole batch.
